description: Derived controlled-language dictionary for the LAAS banking profile. The markdown tables in banking.md section 3 are authoritative; this file is derived from them. Each term carries exactly one approved meaning and one part of speech (STE-C-04). No term appears in both the nouns list and the verbs list.

nouns.meaning: A ledger record, identified by an account number, that holds a balance for one party.
The legal party in whose name an account is opened.
The ledger balance minus authorization holds and uncleared items. The amount that can fund a payment now.
A reduction of available balance that reserves funds against a future posting.
A set of payment instructions submitted to a rail as one unit under one selection rule.
The party that receives funds from a payment instruction.
A transfer between two accounts on the same ledger, with no external rail.
A forced return of a card payment initiated by the card scheme on the payer's behalf.
The scheduled window in which a rail exchanges and nets instructions before settlement.
The external institution or party on the other side of a payment or a trade.
A ledger entry that increases a liability account or decreases an asset account.
The maximum exposure permitted to a named counterparty or account holder.
A ledger entry that increases an asset account or decreases a liability account.
The amount at risk to a named counterparty, stated as a number and a currency code.
The system of record for the institution's accounting entries.
A paired set of debit entries and credit entries that balance to zero.
An open investigation record about the identity or the risk rating of an account holder.
The sum of posted entries on an account. It excludes authorization holds.
A recorded decision to permit an action that exceeds a credit limit or a payment limit.
A standing authority granted by an account holder that permits a named party to initiate payments.
A demand for additional collateral against an exposure.
The party that initiates a payment instruction.
A single instruction to move a stated amount from one account to a named beneficiary.
The maximum amount permitted for one payment instruction or for one period.
The external network that carries a payment instruction between institutions.
The date on which an entry is recorded in the general ledger.
A difference between two records of the same position that is not yet explained.
A payment instruction that the receiving institution has sent back before or after settlement.
A match between a payment party and a sanctions list entry, pending disposition.
The point after which a payment cannot be unwound by the originating institution.
One of initiated, pending, settled, returned, cancelled.
A customer-facing record of account activity for a stated period.
The record that states the agreed terms of a trade between two counterparties.
The unique identifier of one payment instruction on one rail.
The date on which funds become available to the beneficiary and interest begins.
A payment instruction carried by a high-value rail, settled individually rather than netted.

verbs.meaning: Change a recorded amount by posting a new journal entry.
Record a named party's decision to permit an action.
Prevent an action from proceeding, with the reason recorded.
Withdraw a payment instruction before it reaches settlement finality.
Post a credit entry to a named account.
Post a debit entry to a named account.
Refuse a request from an account holder or a counterparty.
Route a decision to a named queue or a named approver.
Attach a recorded marker to an account, a case, or an instruction.
Suspend all outbound movement on a named account.
Submit a payment instruction to a payment rail.
Permit an action that exceeds a stated limit, with the approver recorded.
Record a journal entry in the general ledger.
Match two records of the same position and explain each difference.
Remove a hold so that a payment instruction proceeds to a payment rail.
Send a received payment instruction back to the originating institution.
Post a compensating journal entry that offsets a prior posted entry. The prior entry remains.
Compare a payment party against a named list and record the result.
Reach settlement finality for a payment instruction on a payment rail.
Deliver a record to a named downstream system.
Stop a process temporarily, with a stated resumption condition.
Compare a claim against an independent source and record the result.
Cancel an instruction before any entry is posted. No compensating entry is required.
Remove an uncollectable amount from an asset account by posting a journal entry.

forbidden.reason: Means ledger balance or available balance. The difference decides whether a payment can be funded.
Means pass through a clearing cycle, dispose of a screening hit, or erase. Three meanings, opposite consequences.
forbidden.replacement: settle, or dispose of the sanctions screening hit, or delete

forbidden.reason: In ordinary English it means resolve a dispute. In this domain it means settlement finality, which is irreversible.
forbidden.replacement: settle only for finality; resolve for a dispute

forbidden.reason: A reversal does not undo a payment. See rule STE-BANK-03.
forbidden.replacement: reverse only for a compensating entry; state money reversibility separately

forbidden.reason: Means record a journal entry in this domain.
forbidden.replacement: post only for the ledger; publish for making a record visible

forbidden.reason: Means payment authorization or access authorization.
forbidden.replacement: approve for a decision; grant access for a permission

forbidden.reason: Collides with the consequence enum value in conformance/laas/data.json.
forbidden.replacement: the enum value, or a stated number and threshold

forbidden.reason: Reads as a fact but is a computed quantity with a timestamp.
Means authorization hold, freeze, or suspend.
forbidden.replacement: place an authorization hold, freeze, or suspend

forbidden.reason: An unstated bulk movement across accounts.
forbidden.replacement: initiate a book transfer with the named accounts
adjust, with the amount and the journal entry

forbidden.reason: Idiom for an unspecified reversal or cancellation.

forbidden.replacement: the exposure amount, the limit, and the difference
the actor_id or the named component
